request.style: English, male deep voice solo with backing choir, acoustic guitar, upright bass, harmonica, electric guitar, organ, mournful and resilient mood, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Three months passed on the island shore
We put to sea in Alexandria's hold
Twin Brothers on the bow we saw
Syracuse and Rhegium on the road
Puteoli brothers welcomed us home
Seven days we stayed before we roam
To Rome where the Forum of Appius stood
Paul saw them and thanked God for his blood

[Pre-Chorus]
He was allowed to live with his guard
Three days later the leaders came to the yard
He said I did nothing against our fathers
Yet I was handed over to Caesar's doors

[Chorus]
I am wearing this chain for the hope of Israel
Laying out the kingdom of God before us
From morning until evening he spoke the truth
Convincing some while others remained in the booth

[Verse]
They had no letters from Judea to show
Nor bad reports from the brothers below
But they wanted to hear what he thought of the sect
Spoken against in every part of the net
So they set a day and came in crowds great
To his lodging where the light was late
From Moses and Prophets he tried to persuade
About Jesus with truth that they could not fade

[Pre-Chorus]
Some were convinced by the words he had spoken
Others would not believe and the truth was broken
They disagreed and began to leave
With heated arguments in the heat

[Chorus]
I am wearing this chain for the hope of Israel
Laying out the kingdom of God before us
From morning until evening he spoke the truth
Convincing some while others remained in the booth

[Bridge]
The Holy Spirit spoke through Isaiah's pen
You will listen and listen but never understand
Hearts have grown dull and eyes are shut tight
So they may not see or hear the light
God's salvation is sent to the Gentiles now
And they will listen to the voice of the vow

[Outro]
Two whole years in his rented place
Proclaiming the kingdom with boldness and grace
Without hindrance he taught the Lord
With complete boldness until the very end
